messages:
maria: FYI - saw an ~18% p99 regression on mixtral-8x after the kernel-selector change + AWQ rollout. KV cache hit rate dropped ~22% vs GPTQ baseline.
kevin: do you have traces/flamegraphs? commit/selector id?
maria: quick logs:
```
[1748001109] kernel_selector v2.3.2: selected=generic_matmul fallback=optimized_attn_v2 reason="head_dim_mismatch (expected 64, got 80)"
[1748001110] kv_cache: hit_rate=0.61 -> 0.48
```
maria: commit 6b3fa7d changed the kernel signature (prefetch stride) + batcher window tuned to 6ms
sandeep: that head_dim mismatch + RoPE scaling differences on mixtral variants can change kernel signature hashes. AWQ path also emits different per-layer scales which can trigger fallback to generic kernels. likely explains perf hit.
tara: can we force the older kernel to validate? KERNEL_OVERRIDE=optimized_attn_v1 might be a quick canary.
perf-ci: ran microbench (seq=1024, b=1):
- baseline (GPTQ + selector v2.3.1): p50 28ms p99 62ms kv_hit 0.71
- new (AWQ + selector v2.3.2): p50 33ms p99 73ms kv_hit 0.49
- forced old kernel (KERNEL_OVERRIDE=optimized_attn_v1): p50 29ms p99 63ms kv_hit 0.70
kevin: looks like kernel fallback is the culprit. we should avoid selector churn on minor kernel-signature diffs. propose adding a relaxed match for head_dim +/- 8 and prefer specialized kernels.
maria: also seeing small quality delta on AWQ w/ current calibration prompts (BLEU-like eval delta ~0.8%). will re-run with longer calibration set.
kevin: batching heuristics could amplify this - when kernel is slower it expands queue and pulls more seqs into same batch. try decreasing max_batch_time_ms from 6 -> 3 for canary.
sandeep: i'll re-run AWQ calib with the 'rope_sensitive' prompt set and post accuracy vs gptq. command: `scripts/awq_calib.py --model mixtral-8x --prompts calib/rope_sensitive_prompts.txt --quant awq --out out/awq_mixtral_rope.json`
maria: plan: 1) force old kernel on a small fleet 2) rerun AWQ calib with expanded prompts 3) push relaxed kernel-selector matching + batch window tweak to staging. rollouts next 48h. @kevin @sandeep can you own steps 2/3?
kevin: on it.
sandeep: will post evals in this thread. :thumbsup:
